name: Date Salad With Spicy Tahini-Yogurt Dressing

ingredients.name: kosher salt, plus more to taste
kosher salt, plus more to taste

instructions.primary_message: Pit and quarter the Medjool dates. Juice the lemon. Juice the lemon. Finely grate or mince the garlic. Halve the Persian cucumbers lengthwise, then thinly slice them. Thinly slice the radishes.
instructions.secondary_message:
10 Medjool dates
½ lemon
½ lemon
1 medium clove garlic
3 Persian cucumbers
2 small radishes

instructions.primary_message: For the Dates: In a small bowl, combine dates, lemon juice, and orange blossom water, if using. Toss well and let stand at room temperature until softened, at least 15 minutes. (Continue to step 2 while dates soak.)

For the Dressing: In a medium bowl, whisk together tahini, yogurt, apple cider vinegar, lemon juice, gochunjang, sriracha, or harissa, sugar, garlic, salt, and water. Whisk until dressing is smooth and pourable, adjusting with more water, 1 teaspoon at a time, as needed. Taste and adjust with additional salt as needed.

For the Salad: In a large bowl, combine lettuce, cucumbers, radishes, mint, salt, and reserved dates. Drizzle with about three-quarters of the dressing and toss gently until evenly coated. Add more dressing as desired, saving any leftover dressing for another use. Season to taste with salt if needed. Transfer to a large serving platter, top with sesame seeds, and serve immediately.

description: This easy salad combines sweet Medjool dates, bitter radicchio, crunchy cucumbers, fresh mint, and a spicy tahini-yogurt dressing for a bold, crunchy dish that's company-worthy but easy enough for weeknights.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 1 teaspoon orange blossom water (optional)

Optional substitutions: gochujang → sriracha or harissa

Notes: I prefer gochujang in this salad for its savory-sweet depth; for a brighter, more vinegary heat, use sriracha, and for a smokier, more complex heat, use harissa.

Make-ahead and storage: The dressing can be prepared up to 4 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container. Loosen with water as needed before serving.
The dates can be macerated and refrigerated in an airtight container up to 1 day in advance.
author: Laila Ibrahim
